title: 9/22/2026 | JUDI BEAUFORD | LTRS | RE FILING 6594. LETTER IN SUPPORT OF THE KENNEDY-BURROW REQUEST FOR AN INDEPENDENT EVALUATION AND FORENSIC AUDIT

=== PDF LETTER RE INDEPENDENT EVAL.pdf ===
September 22 , 2026

Via Email and PUCT Interchange

The Honorable Greg Abbott
Governor, State of Texas

Re: REQUEST FOR AN INDEPENDENT TECHNICAL INVESTIGATION AND FORENSIC
AUDIT OF ERCOT'S 2024 PERMIAN BASIN RELIABILITY PLAN MODELING

Dear Governor Abbott:

I support Kevin Kennedy’s and John Burrow’s request in item 6571 for an independent
technical investigation and forensic audit of the modeling underlying the 2024 Permian Basin
Reliability Plan.

Before irreversible actions are taken, I ask the Commission to obtain an independent
evaluation of the modeling assumptions and reconcile material di erences between the PBRP
and the 2024 Regional Transmission Plan. After such an independent evaluation, I humbly ask
for a public explanation whether each 765 import path remains justi ed.

I support a pause in all import path projects while the independent evaluation is completed and
reviewed.

My support for such an independent evaluation in no way presumes misconduct or a
predetermined result. It simply re ects my interest as a Texan in having decisions of this scale
and size done correctly.

I understand the importance of strengthening the Texas electrical grid. I lived for two weeks,
isolated, snowed in, during Storm Uri with rolling blackouts. I live in an old farmhouse with no
central AC or heat. I have one propane heater that keeps my pipes from freezing. I have
chosen to live where I do, and I am tough. I do believe Texans need reliable electricity to live
productively.

I am not an engineer, but I know Kevin Kennedy and his intelligence in these matters. I do not
know John Burrows, but I understand from Kevin that John is a highly accomplished individual.
I urge you to listen to them. I believe they have the best interests of Texans at heart.

I am a retired teacher and an artist. I am acquainted with the plein air work of Texas artist
Frank Reaugh. Please remember Frank Reaugh and his commitment to painting the Texas
west and the panhandle plains while he was alive. At the very least, please allow for the
independent evaluation that Mr. Kennedy and Mr. Burrow are seeking.

Thank you,

Judi Beauford
P.O. Box 83
Bertram, Texas
78605
ranch.d0g.jack@gmail.com
